title: Golden Corpus - Difference Line Graph
description: Golden-corpus representative page for a LineGraph in comparisonMode difference — the signed value axis. Kept live intentionally, not disposable. Guards the 2026-09-16 fix where the line graph's y-domain floor was pinned at 0, so the negative half of a difference series rendered outside the section.

graphs.title: Difference in average speed by 5-minute epoch
graphs.why: Reproduces the reported repro shape exactly: one route in two date windows, subtracted. A same-route year-over-year speed difference straddles zero at 5-minute grain, so the rendered y-domain must go negative — the assertion this corpus entry exists to make.
